name: Remove Effect
description: Disable certain visual effects in the game.

discord-mute.name: Auto Discord Mute
discord-mute.description: Simule un appui de touche à un certain % du niveau (utile pour muter Discord)

discord-mute-percent.name: Trigger Percent
discord-mute-percent.description: Pourcentage du niveau à partir duquel la touche sera simulée

discord-mute-key.name: Virtual Key Code
discord-mute-key.description: Code de la touche (VK) à simuler. Ex: 113=F2, 114=F3, 115=F4, 118=F7. Full list: learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/inputdev/virtual-key-codes

orb-pulse-size.name: Orb Pulse Size
orb-pulse-size.description: The size of the orb pulse effect

force-16-9.name: Force 16:9
force-16-9.description: Adds black letterbox bars to display the game in 16:9
